title: 第19章 要搞就搞一波大的第20章 集合
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
一行人离开聚居地，沿着蜿蜒的林间小径穿行，不多时便来到一处被活体荆棘严密围拢的林地前。
高达数米的荆棘墙如巨蟒交缠，深褐色的藤蔓表面布满了尖锐倒刺，在微风中缓缓蠕动，发出令人牙酸的摩擦声。
里面隐约传来低沉的嘶吼，像是有某种野兽在徘徊，却无法逃脱这座荆棘囚笼。
菲恩停下脚步，回身看向众人。
“在课程开始之前，我先讲解一下规则。”
“这处场地已经投放了数以百计的蜥蜴人，你们接下来要做的就是进入里面，猎杀它们。”
“每头蜥蜴人的心口正中央都有一片特殊的鳞片，上面写有数字，代表你们杀死它们后能得到的积分，越强大的蜥蜴人，鳞片上的数字越高。”
“课程结束后，统计所有人的积分，分数最高者，可以获得一滴生命泉水作为奖励。”
菲恩顿了顿，目光在安东等新人身上停留了一瞬，“今天第一次参加实战课程的新人里，积分最高者，奖励一截永恒树枝。”
人群中顿时响起一阵压抑的骚动。
尤其是新人，更是两眼发光。
生命泉水可以快速恢复伤势，能治愈大部分疾病、毒药和诅咒。
永恒树枝随身携带，不仅能快速恢复精力，还能隔绝大部分毒素和诅咒。
无论哪一种，都是异常珍贵的宝贝。
就算是艾莉诺这些参加过多次实战课程的老生，听到奖励时也有些动容。
安东静静听着，目光微动。
银月氏族背靠生命泉水和永恒之树这两大宝库，每年能产出的珍贵材料，价值之高是外人难以想象的。
生命泉水和永恒树枝仅仅是其中之二。
只可惜银月氏族每年都要将大半珍贵材料上贡给克瑞索龙城，自己只能留下一小部分，因此存量一直捉襟见肘，自己人反而要省着用。
“无论是生命泉水，还是永恒树枝，生命力和元素能量都极为浓郁，如果能弄到手，说不定可以替代丹方中的某些材料，甚至直接用来炼丹或炼器。”

安东在心中默默盘算。
修仙界的丹药和法器，最看重的便是材料的灵性和生机。
而精灵族的这两样东西，论品阶绝对算得上是天材地宝级别的灵材。
“要是能搞到一批......”
安东思绪飘远，随即又自嘲地摇摇头。
这两样东西平日里优先供应森林卫队。
普通族人，尤其是他这样的未成年精灵，想要批量使用，简直是白日做梦。
除非哪一天他成了银月氏族的族长。
听到奖励，罗曼本来也很兴奋，可转头看到安东，整个人又蔫了下去。
有安东在，她根本不可能拿到新人第一的奖励。
至于全员第一......她虽然对自己的实力很自信，但也不觉得自己能赢过所有前辈。
尤其是艾莉诺这样的天才。
她的天赋或许不比艾莉诺差，但后者比她多修炼了足足二十多年，这差距短时间内很难追平。
“看来永恒树枝是你的了。”罗曼低声嘀咕。
安东微微一笑，没说什么。
content_en:
The group left the settlement and walked along the winding forest path. Not long after, they came to a woodland tightly surrounded by living thorns.
The several-meter-high thorn wall is intertwined like a giant python. The surface of the dark brown vines is covered with sharp barbs. They slowly squirm in the breeze, making a tooth-breaking friction sound.
There was a faint roar coming from inside, as if there was some kind of wild beast wandering around, but there was no way to escape from this thorn cage.
Finn stopped and turned around to look at everyone.
"Before the class begins, let me explain the rules."
"Hundreds of lizardmen have been released into this site. What you have to do next is to enter and hunt them."
"Each lizard man has a special scale in the center of his heart. There are numbers written on it, which represent the points you can get after killing them. The more powerful the lizard man, the higher the number on the scale."
"After the course, everyone's points will be tallied up. The one with the highest score will be rewarded with a drop of life spring water."
Finn paused, his eyes lingering on Anton and other newcomers for a moment, "Among the newcomers who participated in the practical course for the first time today, the one with the highest points will be rewarded with an eternal branch."
There was a suppressed commotion in the crowd.
Especially the newcomers’ eyes are shining.
The fountain of life can quickly restore injuries and cure most diseases, poisons and curses.
Carrying the Eternal Branch with you everywhere not only quickly restores your energy, but also blocks out most toxins and curses.
No matter which kind, they are all extremely precious treasures.
Even veterans like Eleanor, who had participated in many practical courses, were a little moved when they heard the rewards.
Anton listened quietly, his eyes moving slightly.
The Silver Moon Clan is backed by two major treasures: the Spring of Life and the Tree of Eternity. The precious materials it produces every year are of such value that outsiders cannot imagine.
The fountain of life and the eternal branch are just two of them.
It's a pity that the Silver Moon Clan has to donate most of its precious materials to Cresso Dragon City every year, and can only keep a small part of it. Therefore, the stock has always been stretched thin, and its own people have to use sparingly.
"Whether it is the spring of life or the eternal branch, the vitality and elemental energy are extremely rich. If you can get it, it may be able to replace some of the materials in the elixir, or even be used directly to make elixirs or refine weapons."
Anton was calculating silently in his mind.
In the world of immortality, the most important thing about elixirs and magic weapons is the spirituality and vitality of the materials.
As for these two things from the elves, they can definitely be regarded as spiritual materials at the level of heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
"If I could just get a batch..."
Anton's thoughts drifted away, and then he shook his head mockingly.
These two items are usually given priority to the Forest Guards.
For ordinary tribesmen, especially underage elves like him, it is simply a daydream to use it in bulk.
Unless one day he becomes the patriarch of the Silver Moon clan.
Roman was originally very excited when he heard the reward, but when he turned around and saw Anton, he felt weak again.
With Anton here, it would be impossible for her to get the reward for being the first newcomer.
As for being first among all members... Although she is very confident in her own strength, she doesn't think she can beat all her seniors.
Especially a genius like Eleanor.
Her talent may not be worse than Eleanor's, but the latter has practiced more than her for more than twenty years, and this gap will be difficult to equal in a short time.
"It seems that the eternal branch is yours." Roman whispered.
Anton smiled slightly and said nothing.
